notes.title: New update - fixes and changes based on community feedback!
notes.notes:
We manage to make one more cool update with the community!
This update fix issues add some small history elements as well.
If want any new feature or want to report a bug please let us know!!

/cheers guys, see you on the next update!

notes.title: May update!
notes.notes:
On this huge update we manage to fix a lot of "black screens" and the "skybox screen" glitches that sometimes used to happens in different places.
We balanced the skills, specially the bridge one.
We also fixed some other minor issues, and optmized even more the game.
If you have any issue, please let us know!

Cheers.
